summary: Test tagging changes safely before they go live, and bring over the rest of what v1 did.

new.title: Test runs for tagging
new.text: Test run tries your rules on the people you pick and writes nothing, or only their tags. Test queued changes before you commit, then Go live runs them on everyone.

new.title: Identity report in Log Analytics
new.text: Each identity report can go to your Log Analytics workspace as v1 did, with v1's exposure lists on the Identity page.
new.action: Run the Log Analytics setup script once, then a SuperAdmin switches on Send the report to Log Analytics in Settings > Identity report.

new.title: Mail through your own SMTP relay
new.text: Alert mail and the report can go through your own mail relay, with any password kept in your Key Vault. The workbook can go to its own recipients.

new.title: Policies edited by picking, not typing
new.text: The Conditional Access Edit and Clone form shows names with an Add button and a dropdown for every fixed choice. The choices come from Microsoft Graph and stay current.
new.action: Run the install once more to add the monthly job that reads the choices.

new.title: More control and safer clean-up
new.text: Export and import the whole configuration, remove policies that are off with a backup first, restore named locations from a backup, and set log levels per feature. CA Policy Analyzer gets v1's options.

fixes.title: Fallback values protected from removal
fixes.text: A tag type's fallback value can no longer be removed on Tag types. Change the fallback first.

fixes.title: Jobs show times in your time zone
fixes.text: Jobs shows each next start in the schedule's time zone, and you pick times on a 24-hour clock.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Tables no longer show a filter box over a column of buttons, and an object's tag changes are one click from Tamper.
